notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapping to person_source_value in the person table.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation. A custom concept for the weight type would be needed in observation_concept_id.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored as a numeric observation. A custom concept for the weight type would be needed in observation_concept_id.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall, stored as a number in observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating completeness/reliability. Requires mapping to a standard concept for dietary recall status; if unavailable, store as source value.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer, stored as a string in observation. Could also be linked to provider table if interviewers are considered providers.
Breast-fed infant status is a binary variable. Map to standard Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539 'Yes', 4188540 'No') in value_as_concept_id.
Number of days of intake is categorical (e.g., 1 or 2 days). Map to standard concepts for counts or store as number if appropriate.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric variable, stored as value_as_number.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Map to standard concepts for days of the week (e.g., OMOP Days of the week vocabulary).
Language respondent used mostly is categorical. Map to standard language concepts (e.g., OMOP Language vocabulary).
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination food types, stored as a number in observation.
Combination food type is categorical (e.g., beverage, sandwich). Map to standard concepts for food types if available, otherwise store as source value.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) is a time value. OMOP does not have a dedicated time field; store as string in value_as_string or convert to numeric minutes since midnight in value_as_number.
Name of eating occasion (e.g., breakfast, lunch) is categorical. Map to standard concepts for meal types if available (e.g., SNOMED concepts for meals).

Source of food is a categorical variable describing where food was obtained. It can be mapped to an observation with a custom concept representing the source category (e.g., store, restaurant). No standard concept_id exists; use value_as_concept_id with a local concept.

Binary indicator for whether meal was eaten at home. Can be represented as an observation with a custom Yes/No concept. Alternatively, could use value_as_number (1/0) but categorical representation is preferred.

USDA food code is an identifier for the food item. It is not a standard OMOP concept; store as a string in observation. Could also be placed in observation_source_value if a custom concept is created.
Grams of food consumed. This is a quantity measurement. No standard concept for 'food weight in grams' exists; use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Energy in kcal. Standard concept for 'Energy' (kcal) is 4322389. Unit concept_id for kilocalorie is 9705.
Protein in grams. Standard concept for 'Protein intake' is 40762433. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Carbohydrate in grams. Standard concept for 'Carbohydrate intake' is 40762432. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Total sugars in grams. No direct standard concept for total sugars intake; use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Dietary fiber in grams. Standard concept for 'Fiber intake' is 40762434. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Total fat in grams. Standard concept for 'Total fat intake' is 40762435. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Saturated fatty acids in grams. No direct standard concept; use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Monounsaturated fatty acids in grams. No direct standard concept; use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Polyunsaturated fatty acids in grams. No direct standard concept; use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for gram is 8587.
Cholesterol in mg. Standard concept for 'Cholesterol intake' is 40762436. Unit concept_id for milligram is 9655.
Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol in mg. No direct standard concept for alpha-tocopherol intake; use a custom measurement concept. Unit concept_id for milligram is 9655.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) intake in mg. Maps to measurement of nutrient intake. Concept_id for Vitamin E.
